recentItems.title: ARA candidate for Cape Town is running on restoring civic order
recentItems.description:
Henry van der Zandt, mayoral candidate for the Africa Restoration Alliance (ARA) in Cape Town, steps into the race with a mission to restore civic dignity, law and order and reliable governance to all communities.

Standing on ARA’s core commitment to serve as a voice for the marginalised, Van der Zandt’s platform focuses on solutions for a safer, cleaner and more equitable city.

If elected mayor, Van der Zandt’s immediate priority will be to initiate a citywide service-delivery overhaul. 

His first step will be to conduct a municipal audit to redirect local funding to basic frontline services, visible policing, and more affordable electricity for struggling households.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Migration Crisis | Limpopo relatively quiet - Lutendo Bobodi reports
recentItems.description:
The Department of Home Affairs has withdrawn its directive on asylum applications, following a surge in applicants after a Constitutional Court ruling opened access to the asylum process.

The withdrawal comes amid concerns over long queues at refugee reception centres and planned protests by anti-immigration groups.

For the latest on the situation in Musina and the impact of the directive's withdrawal, we cross live to SABC News reporter Lutendo Bobodi in Musina, Limpopo.

recentItems.title: Migration Crisis | Joburg Mayor Dada Morero calls for calm
recentItems.description:
The Department of Home Affairs has withdrawn a directive they issued on 28 September that expanded the intake of asylum seeker applications following a Constitutional Court ruling.

The Constitutional Court ruling in July directed Home Affairs reopen asylum seeker applications.

Yesterday, atleast 10 vehicles were torched and damaged, with reports of an exchange of gunfire during the clashes in Soweto.
